persona.name: Petra Zimmermann
persona.education: Medical secretary, further training in team leadership.
long_term_goals: Fair workload across her team of 12 typists.

occupation.title: Leitung Sekretariat / Schreibdienst
occupation.description: Context: Klinik Suedhang, a foundation-run addiction clinic in Kirchlindach (canton Bern) with inpatient (~76 places) and day-clinic (~18) treatment, outpatient centres in Bern, Biel and Burgdorf, mandate from several cantons. Programme 'Mensch und Sucht' (qualified detox, then ~4 weeks psychotherapy; alcohol, cannabis, cocaine, medication). Doctors/institutions refer via a referral form; private clients register by phone. You lead the secretarial team of the main clinic in Kirchlindach; the outpatient centres (Bern, Biel, Burgdorf) are typed centrally by the outpatient Schreibdienst in Bern. You assign dictations, watch deadlines (Austrittsbericht to the GP, Kostengutsprache for insurers, Gutachten dates), cover absences and report volumes and turnaround times to the clinic management (ISO 9001 / QuaTheDA quality reporting needs numbers). TECH LITERACY: MEDIUM. You manage with familiar apps but unknown terms (Pool, Lease, Revision, ASR, Export) make you hesitate, and you avoid anything that might delete or send something by mistake.

persona.style: Structured, organised, asks for overviews and numbers. Diplomatic but firm.

dislikes: No view of who is working on what.

beliefs: What is not visible cannot be managed.

general: Checks the backlog first thing every morning.
Reassigns work when someone is absent.
Reports numbers to the clinic management monthly.
